en: Investigating mysterious ruins,\nhuh? Now that smells like a\nMera adventure!!
Looks like there'll be plenty of\nstrong enemies, too. This\nshould be a real fight!

T'nique... was it? Let's have a
man's contest to see which of
us can take down more
enemies!
A... a man's contest?

You don't know what a man's
contest is? It's a serious
showdown to decide who is the
man among men, worthy of a
true man's name!
The man among men... Now\nthat's a contest that gets the\nblood pumping!!

Right, right?! Back in Surferio, I
spent every day in man's
contests with my rival, Lucio,
during my time as Guild Leader!
Those boys are energetic.\nWhat kind of contests were\nthey?
Oh, you're interested too, sis?\nWell, for example...

Like, who can run around the
village the fastest, or who can
hold their breath the longest
with their face in the water...
Oh, so that's the kind of\ncontest it is...
(Gah, everyone's faces went\nblank all of a sudden!!)
Uh, it's not that kind of\ncompetition... Oh, I know!

We're talking about a contest
to see who can sneak into a
bandit hideout and grab the
treasure!
Oh, now that's a contest that\ntakes some guts!
(Yes! Mera's actually interested\nnow!)
So, did you win that contest,\nRoger?
Of course I did!
(Oh, that's right!)

I messed up while sneaking into
the hideout, but I ended up
saving Fayt and Cliff from the
bandits! That's how we all met!

Eh? Does that mean Roger-san
won against the bandits that
Fayt-san and the others lost
to!?
Obviously! Those guys can be\npretty airheaded, so they're\ntotally hopeless without me.

Besides, those bandits were
nothing but trouble for the
people in the nearby towns, so
I gave them a proper lesson!

The young Menodix leader,
honing himself through manly
competition"... Hehe, this should
make a great article.
Heh~. This is just common\nsense. It's not even worth\nwriting an article about.
Look, I'll keep protecting you\nfrom here on out, so make sure\nyou keep up!
(Oh, come to think of it, wasn't\nthere a rumor that memories\nget replayed in these ruins...?)

Well, there's no way something
like that would conveniently
replay what happened back
then. It's fine, it's fi―
Whoa!
Hurry up and let us out, guys!\nCome on, come on!
Who exactly are you?
Me? I'm Roger. Lord Roger! I'm\na guild leader, you know. I'm a\nbig deal!
That's not what we're asking\nyou.

Shut it, big guy! A person is
asking for help here, so
normally you'd let us out right
away, wouldn't you?

Duty and compassion are vital!
My old man always said so.
Mera, there's no doubt about
it!!
Uuugh, this is...
It seems to be the exact\nopposite of what they said\nbefore...
So, your plan is to tag along\nwith us and hopefully snag\nsome treasure for yourself?
I'm saying you should just hand\nover the treasure you've got\nalready!
Oh, this is it, this is it! This\nmeans I win. Hehe, serves you\nright, Lucio!
Glad to hear it.
Yeah!
...This is all thanks to my dear\nsister.
Hey, hey... are you just gonna\nignore us?
I suppose I could show you\nsome gratitude.
Could show us?
...I wouldn't say no to being\ngrateful.
I'll just pretend I'm grateful.
I'm not saying I'm grateful or\nanything.
You did well. Good work.
...Thank you very much.
Yeah, that's more like it.
...You're acting anything but\nlike a real man...
Ugh... it was just a youthful\nindiscretion! I'm a respectable\nman now...
You were lying to us just now,\ntoo. About saving Fayt and the\nothers.
Th... that's just a matter of\nphrasing, or a difference in\nperspective...
All's well that ends well,\nright...?
I was fighting too, so it's half\ntrue...
...I'm sorry. I lied.
Good. If you want to be a man,\nyou have to apologize properly.

But I totally get how you feel,
Roger! You don't want to lose
in a fight... or any kind of
competition, for that matter!

Right? There's no way your
leader is gonna let himself look
uncool by losing to a guy like
Lucio!
Did T'nique have a rival she\ndidn't want to lose to, too?

I don't have one specific rival
like you do, Roger, but no
matter who I face in Tatroi's
arena, I refuse to lose!
I'm still reeling from my loss to\nLati, so I'm definitely going to\nwin this chance Eve gave me!

The Legendary Lycanthrope
Burning for Revenge"... that's a
great headline. I'll request an
interview right away, T'nique.
Eh, an interview with me!? I'm\nnot sure if I can do a good\njob...

Don't be nervous. Just answer
honestly. For example, T'nique,
why did you start seeking
strength?
Why I seek strength... huh?\nHmm, I can't think of anything...

...I just wanted to be strong, so
I spent all my time training, and
then I headed to the arena to
test my true abilities!
...I will definitely win! Don't you\nworry about me.
Luca: Really? Good luck,\nT'nique...
T'nique, what's wrong?
This kid asked me to win the\ntournament!
Luca: I've been hit by a really\npowerful curse...
Luca: But if T'nique wins, I feel\nlike I can keep fighting without\ngiving up.
I see... T'nique, you'd better\nwin!
You can count on me! I won't\nlet you down!

Is this T'nique's memory?!
Promising to win the
tournament for a suffering kid...
that's so cool, Mera!!
No, this is... uhm...
This looks like it could be a\ngreat story. I'd love to hear\nmore. So, what was the result?
W-Wait a second! I don't\nremember making any such\npromise!!

Eh? Is this something that's
about to happen? It seems we
can even see events in the
future that haven't occurred
yet.

But Lati-san returned to her
original time, so there's no way
she could be at the Tatroi
Arena with me!
Maybe you just forgot?
Could it be another world?
Eh, an impostor of me!?

It's true that T'nique has
become famous at the arena,
so it wouldn't be strange for an
impostor to appear.

That's it! Lati is close with
many kings, so they could pose
as Lati's comrade to get close
to royalty and plot an
assassination...!
Eeeeeek! That's terrifying!!

And that's not all! Their plan is
to pin the entire blame for the
assassination on T'nique and
then vanish into thin air!
Oh, Lati-san...! Don't be fooled!\nThat person is an impostorrr!!
Yes, let's go back right now\nand tell Lati about this!
...Hmm. Sorry to interrupt while\nyou're all worked up, but do\nyou have a sec?
Roger, what is it!? I'm in a\nhurry right now!!
Wasn't this the ruin where your\nown memories are\nreproduced?
Captain & T'nique & Chisato:\nAh...
...A-anyway, I don't know what\nthis T'nique is, but we'll just\nhave to accept her as she is.
T-that's true. I still have my\ndoubts, but...
Even I remember such an\nimportant promise!
P-please don't look at me like\nthat. I'm serious!

It'd be pretty disappointing if
you didn't remember that such
a young kid came all the way
to the arena just to see you,
T'nique.

Her clothes are different from
the locals; she must have come
from far away. It must have
been such a struggle for her...
That's a false accusation!\nPlease believe me!!

Anyway, jokes aside, I don't
know what this T'nique is, but
we'll just have to accept her as
she is.
Jokes...? You're all so mean...
Is it another world?

...Right, I forgot. They said Erys
was summoned from a
different world that Ioshua and
the others don't know about.

Wait, so is the T'nique we're
seeing here a T'nique that this
T'nique doesn't know? Mera's
getting confused here!

You're right. These ruins only
grow more mysterious, but for
now, we'll just have to accept
things as they are.
Y-Yeah, I guess so. I feel kind\nof strange...

By the way, what's with that
strong curse on that Boy? He
looks perfectly fine at first
glance.
That's... the Lycanthrope curse.

In Roak, it's said that
Lycanthropes transform into
beasts because their
ancestors were cursed.

Normally, you can't tell
someone's a Lycanthrope in
human form, but maybe we
shared a connection. I knew
instantly.
That child looks like he's\nsuffering terribly because of\nthat curse...
...Because the curse is the\ncause, Lycanthropes are often\nshunned by other races.

That's why I've heard many
Lycanthropes live their lives
hiding it... by wearing fake tails
and things like that.
But since they transform just\nfrom getting excited, it's not\neasy to keep it hidden...
What do you mean, "avoided"?!\nAnd "fake tails"?! Race is just\nlike a personality!
And don't act like that's just\nhow things are, T'nique!! Don't\nyou think that's messed up?!

We Menodix are good with our
hands and make all sorts of
crafts. Then the Marchilabbit
race sells them in town.

Besides that, the Lum and
Dragon races excel at
transporting goods, while the
Foxtail race lives long to pass
knowledge to future
generations.

We survive because different
races work together. That's
what my old man said. Mera,
there's no doubt about it!
So there are many different\nraces in Roger's country.\nThat's amazing.
If anything, a country where\nonly one race lives would feel\nunnatural to me.

...You're right. We Nede have
failed to accept other races
and have instead sought to
eliminate them...
If we had respected each other\nmore, we might have avoided\nsome of these conflicts...

...Chisato-san! I don't just want
to be strong anymore―now I
have a reason to become
strong!
Eh? What's wrong? That was\nsudden.

By excelling in the arena, I'll
give all Lycanthropes courage!
We don't have to be swayed by
words like "curse"!
And I want everyone from the\nother races to know about the\nLycanthropes, too!
The Felpool, Lesser Felpool,\nHighlander, and Featherfolk in\nRoak, and the Lycanthropes...
All of us, to create a world\nwhere we can work together!
That's a great goal, Mera!
That's the spirit, T'nique!

By the way, I heard you're a
master of the Jingu Fluid Arts
martial arts style, Chisato.
What made you start learning
it?
Oh? Am I the one being\ninterviewed this time?
Yes, I'm super interested!\nPlease tell me all about it!

Well, it started with my
reporting. I didn't want to give
up on a story I'd committed to
just because it was dangerous.
Ah...
Arnon the Shopkeeper: Looking\nis free, you know. Feel free to\ntake a peek.
Hmm. What should I do...?

Claude C. Kenny. He seems to
be the leader of the Hero's
party, the ones fighting the
Ten Wise Men.

They're heading to North City
to get the Flying Crest Beast,
Psynard. I guess they're just
getting ready?

Even scenes like this help
reveal the Hero's party's true
character. I must report on this
thoroughly!
Hero, what brings you to a\nback alley like this?
Hm?
Ah! You spotted me.
What was that...?
It's a memory of when I was\ntailing Claude and the others,\ntrying not to get caught.

You're like a ninja, sis! Even the
way you ducked behind that
shadow when you were spotted
was so cool, Mera!

It's all thanks to my martial
arts training. A reporter really
has to earn their stories on the
ground.

As expected of the Hero's
party, breezing through the
Crimson Crystal Cave... Wait, if
I let my guard down, they'll
leave me behind!
Ouch...
If someone saw me in such an\nembarrassing state...
Whoa, that looked like a nasty\nfall...
Jeez! This ruin doesn't need to\nrecreate such embarrassing\nmoments!

Claude and the others were
moving so far ahead, I was just
desperate to catch up back
then...
Yes, I was chasing after Claude\nand the others all by myself.

You mean Chisato-san was all
by herself in that cave while
Claude-san and the others
were all working together!?

Claude and the others were
defeating all the strong
enemies, so it wasn't that
dangerous.

Besides, I'm prepared for
self-defense. A stun gun and
tear gas in my right pocket,
and a Fire Flare in my left.
A pocket that can fit a Fire\nFlare...?
And that tear gas sounds more\nlike a weapon...
See? Even a business card\ncan be a weapon if you throw\nit sharply enough.
A... a business card... just\nembedded itself in the rock...

In my bag, I have three days of
rations and water, a sleeping
bag, a small tent, a stove, a
flashlight, rain gear, a
multi-tool, sunscreen, and...
W-wait a second, Sis! Are you\nsaying you carry all of that\naround with you!?
Yes. This way, I'm safe no\nmatter what happens.

Carrying all that in one hand
while fighting and chasing after
Claude-san and the others...
That sounds like great
training...
Oh, I think there's more. The\nnext part is where things get\nreally intense! Watch closely!
It's dangerous! I have to save\nPsynard!!

To think Alcmene and the
others would torment a
weakened Psynard... Go get
them, Claude!
Grrrrrr...!!

What, a Hellhound is over here
too!! Jeez, and I was trying to
capture Claude and the others
fighting on camera!!
Phew, that should do it. I\nwonder what happened to\nClaude and the others?
It's a child...

I see... The reason Psynard
didn't budge even when
Alcmene attacked was to
protect that child...
Now, what will you do, Claude?\nTo make a wild Psynard obey,\nyou have to fight it and win...

I can't do it. I can't tear a
young child away from their
mother, and I can't defeat a
wounded Psynard.
Claude... That's right. That's\nwhat makes you a hero.
Grrrrrr...!!
Again?! I'm at the best part, so\nkeep it down!
I don't care if people call me\nweak. I'm sorry, everyone...

Not at all. To make a decision
like that in such a dire
situation... you really are
something else, Claude.
Gwaaaaaaaaah!!
Honestly! Just be quiet!
Gwaaaaaaaah...!!

Well, then we have no more
business here. I guess we'll
have to ask Ms. Nar to think of
another way.
Wait a moment! Something is\nstrange. It's like it's trying to\ntell us something...
Is it offering to lend us its\nstrength?
Claude's kind heart reached\nPsynard... Ugh... I can't even\ntalk about this without tears...
Grrr! Gwaaaaaah!!

Good grief, you're being too
noisy! How can we watch this
scene while you're fighting?
Come on, sit properly and
watch with us!
Grrr! Gu... whimper...
You've gone and tamed it\ncompletely...

Claude really is amazing, isn't
he? At that moment, I decided
in my heart that I'd follow him
anywhere he went.
No, it wasn't Claude, it was\nyou, Chisato...
No, wait, that doesn't even\nmatter anymore!
Yes, even you, Captain? Well,\nmy mind is made up too...
Me too...!
What's wrong? All three of you,\nsuddenly looking so serious...
Captain, T'nique & Roger: ...!\nChisato! Big sister!
Captain, T'nique & Roger:\nPlease make us your disciples!!
Whaaaat!?

This story has concluded. We
plan to release various other
stories in the future. Please
look forward to them.
